prompt.task: Analyze the following normalized temperature time series data of a processor. Refer to the time over which the data was recorded. The data is represented using the SAX representation (symbollic aggregation approximation).
prompt.data_context_1: The temperature data was measured at 1 second intervals over a 5 minute period. This makes a total of 300 data points, which were then transformed into 10 segments of 30 data points each. The SAX representation was then applied to the segments with the following symbols: a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, w, x, y, z.
prompt.data_context_2: The processor-load data was measured at 1 second intervals over a 5 minute period. This makes a total of 300 data points, which were then transformed into 10 segments of 30 data points each. The SAX representation was then applied to the segments with the following symbols: a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, w, x, y, z.
prompt.desired_output: Provide an analysis of temperature trends and patterns as a function of processor utilization. The response should be structured, starting with key observations, followed by explanations and concluding with possible actions or recommendations to maintain an optimal processor temperature.
